name: Etherhome Seaview Condo
shortDescription: Boutique 40-unit condominium in two six-storey buildings in Rawai, with 1- to 3-bedroom sea-view apartments and a rooftop level.
description:
Etherhome Seaview Condo is a small condominium of 40 apartments in two six-storey buildings in Rawai, at the southern tip of Phuket. It was designed by the Phuket architecture firm Dreamscape and is developed by Eden Home Development, the company behind Eden Rise. The low unit count means only a handful of apartments per floor.
Apartments come in five layouts, from a one-bedroom of about 51 sqm to three-bedroom units of about 182 sqm, plus a top-floor three-bedroom with a large private terrace. Shared facilities include a pool, gym, lobby, garden, two lifts per building, 24-hour security, and concierge, housekeeping and laundry services. Pets are not allowed.
Rawai, Nai Harn and Ya Nui beaches are a few minutes' drive away and Chalong Pier about 2.3 km. The portal lists the building as completed in June 2026; no current asking prices are published, so contact us for availability.
